summary: Lando Norris converts pole position into victory at the treacherous new Madrid circuit, where overtaking proves nearly impossible and McLaren's qualifying masterpiece transforms into a championship statement. George Russell and Mercedes hunt Norris from second, banking on safety car chaos or mechanical failure to exploit the track's high-risk nature and unpredictable racing conditions. A Norris win extends McLaren's constructor lead and tightens his grip on the drivers' championship, potentially shifting momentum decisively before the season's final stretch.
